name: com.gtmswag/gtm-swag
title: GTM Swag
description: Personalized, thoughtful gifts that help GTM teams get meetings. Agents prepare; people approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional workspace key as "Bearer YOUR_GTM_SWAG_KEY". Leave it out to sign in with OAuth.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: GTM Swag helps go-to-market teams get meetings by sending personalized, thoughtful physical gifts to prospects and customers. Agents find a gift that fits each person and the moment (a new role, a webinar, a funding round, a closed deal), add people from Clay, HubSpot or any CRM trigger, and return private gift links for the team's own outreach. Only a signed-in person approves gifts, pays, adds funds or sets auto-approve limits; agents never do.
